selection_reason: MSS-09 completed_verified and owner Continue governed-started MSS-10 from exact current AIOC/application baselines. Implementation authority was bounded to MSS-10 only.
objective: Execute MSS-10 — Portals, Gates & Multiversal Transit. Extend completed MSS-01..09 with source/profile-bound portal, gate and multiversal-transit contracts while preserving World/Reality/Timeline destination authority, Action/Event resolution, Character, Item/Asset, Campaign/GM, visibility, resource, Rune, ritual, counterplay, spirit/relationship and proposal/provenance authorities.

acceptance_profile.portal_endpoints: Portal endpoints and destinations reference existing World/Reality/Timeline or source-owned location identities; MSS-10 owns no duplicate world, reality, scene, era, branch or timeline state.
acceptance_profile.gate_contracts: Gate/portal definitions reference existing World/Scene, Item/Asset, ritual, Rune or source rules and define no universal range, radius, stability, duration, capacity or geometry formula.
acceptance_profile.transit_contracts: Transit plans explicitly identify origin, destination, traveler/subject references, source/rule provenance and disposition; authoritative supernatural execution remains MSS-03-routed and resource mutation remains MSS-02-owned.
acceptance_profile.access_and_activation: Access, activation, closure, key, permission, failure and interruption behavior remains explicit source/profile metadata or GM-adjudicated/unresolved; no invented default portal physics or automatic success/failure.
acceptance_profile.visibility_and_provenance: Hidden destinations, undiscovered routes and GM-only transit facts remain visibility/GM-owned; AI cannot reveal them by authority and proposals cannot mutate canon.
acceptance_profile.temporal_boundary: Temporal/causal branch creation, paradox, retroactive history mutation and timeline governance remain MSS-11-owned; MSS-10 only references existing time/era/timeline destinations without changing them.
acceptance_profile.determinism: Equivalent normalized portal/gate/transit inputs produce identical deterministic checksums across supported platforms.
acceptance_profile.validation: Exact candidate passed application repository health, governed self-hosted Linux and Windows MSS-10 profiles, deterministic cross-platform comparison and exact-head merge before completed_verified closeout.

validation_history.failure: Focused client regression exposed that duplicate gate endpoint references were normalized before distinctness validation, producing the wrong validation branch/message. Candidate was not merged and its receipts do not count toward completion.

validation_history.fix: Validate raw normalized endpoint and transit-subject references for distinctness before deterministic deduplication/sorting.
